newsitem.title: USA: CNA Financial to buy stake in Argentina firm.
newsitem.headline: CNA Financial to buy stake in Argentina firm.

text.p: CNA Financial Corp, the Chicago-based insurance holding company, said Tuesday it has agreed to buy majority control in a subsidiary of Argentine insurance cooperative Omega Seguros.

In an announcement from Buenos Aires, CNA said the investment was its first business venture in Argentina. It did not say how much it was paying for the investment and a CNA spokesman was not available to comment.
Omega Seguros is property and casualty insurer in Argentina that has a 6.0 percent market share in that country. The unit in which CNA is investing is called Aseguardora de Riesgo de Trabajo or ART.
CNA, a multibusiness insurer serving individuals and businesses, had revenues of $16.98 billion in 1996.
